Name: Godly Immersive Time - A Stardew Valley Time Mod
Author: Aerishiph
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#F0BA3C][b]Godly Immersive Time[/b][/color][/size]
[size=4][i]More time for you. Normal time for your machines.[/i][/size][/center]

[line]

[size=5][color=#F0BA3C][b]What it does[/b][/color][/size]

Stardew days go fast. Most time mods fix that by slowing the whole clock, and then your furnaces, kegs and preserves jars slow down with it. You end up waiting just as long for your bars and wine as before. I've always hated that.

[b]Godly Immersive Time slows [i]your[/i] clock, not your machines.[/b]

Your day stretches depending on where you are, while a [b]silent clock[/b] runs in the background at normal game speed and keeps every working machine on schedule. Spend a long day in the mines and your copper bars are still done when they should be.

[line]

[size=5][color=#F0BA3C][b]How much slower?[/b][/color][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Caves: 60% slower.[/b] Mine and Skull Cavern floors, the volcano, the Mutant Bug Lair, the sewers and more.[/*]
[*][b]Indoors: 40% slower.[/b] Houses, shops and buildings.[/*]
[*][b]Outside: 15% slower.[/b] Farming and foraging get a little breathing room.[/*]
[*][b]Machines: normal speed.[/b] Furnaces, kegs, jars and anything else with something in it.[/*]
[/list]
Every number can be changed. Take your time exploring and talking.

[line]

[size=5][color=#F0BA3C][b]Features[/b][/color][/size]

[list]
[*][b]The silent clock.[/b] It counts time at base game pace and tops up working machines with the minutes they're missing. Empty machines are left alone.[/*]
[*][b]Day-based machines are untouched.[/b] Bee houses, tappers and lightning rods work exactly like vanilla.[/*]
[*][b]Fails safe.[/b] Nothing in the game is patched. If anything ever goes wrong, machines just run at the clock's pace. They never freeze.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer friendly.[/b] The slowest player sets the pace, so a friend in the mines gets cave time. Your machines and your friends' machines all stay on normal time.[/*]
[*][b]Cheaty mode (optional).[/b] Stop time completely indoors. In multiplayer, time only stops when everyone is indoors. Machines keep working.[/*]
[*][b]Your own caves.[/b] Add any location to the cave list, including places from other mods.[/*]
[*][b]In-game settings[/b] with Generic Mod Config Menu, or edit config.json.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][color=#F0BA3C][b]Requirements[/b][/color][/size]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or newer[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*][i]Optional:[/i] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for in-game settings[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][color=#F0BA3C][b]Installation[/b][/color][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
In multiplayer, the host's game runs the clock and the silent clock.

[line]

[size=5][color=#F0BA3C][b]Settings[/b][/color][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Cave slowdown:[/b] 60% (default)[/*]
[*][b]Indoor slowdown:[/b] 40% (default)[/*]
[*][b]Outdoor slowdown:[/b] 15% (default)[/*]
[*][b]Cheaty: stop time indoors:[/b] off (default)[/*]
[*][b]Machines at normal speed:[/b] on (default)[/*]
[*][b]Extra caves:[/b] Mine and Skull Cavern entrances, Sewer, Mutant Bug Lair, Caldera, Ginger Island cave and Pirate Cove[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][color=#F0BA3C][b]Console commands[/b][/color][/size]

For the curious, or for tracking down a problem. Type these in the SMAPI window:

[code]gt_help                        list every command
gt_status                      where you are, clock speed, silent clock numbers
gt_where                        the name of this place and what it counts as
gt_watch [on|off]              live log: ticks, speed changes, places, top-ups
gt_machines [here]              every loaded machine and what the silent clock does with it
gt_set cave|indoor|outdoor <%>  change a slowdown (e.g. gt_set cave 60)
gt_set cheaty on|off            stop time indoors
gt_set machines on|off          silent clock on or off
gt_cave list|add|remove [name]  the extra caves list (add with no name = where you're standing)
gt_topup [minutes]              give working machines extra minutes now
gt_reset                        restart today's silent clock count[/code]
[line]

[size=5][color=#F0BA3C][b]Compatibility[/b][/color][/size]

[list]
[*]Don't use it together with other mods that change the speed of the clock. Pick one.[/*]
[*]Mod locations work. Add any you want treated as caves with [b]gt_cave add[/b].[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[center][size=4][color=#F0BA3C][b]Part of the Godly family[/b][/color][/size]
Also check out [b]Godly Voice[/b]: AI conversations with the people of the valley, who remember what you said and spread the word.

[i]Made for a friend who can't play without more time, and for anyone who's tired of turning a time mod off just to let the furnaces catch up.[/i][/center]
